name: Debug hook payload capture
description: Captures the raw postToolUse JSON payload to /tmp/kiro-hook-event.json for debugging. Remove after confirming field names.

then.command: python3 -c "import sys, json; d=sys.stdin.read(); open('/tmp/kiro-hook-event.json','w').write(d); keys=list(json.loads(d).keys()) if d.strip() else []; print('HOOK_DEBUG keys:', keys)"
